issues.claim: Researcher designs/interprets; company provides site access, technician time and existing data. ... company technicians collect samples under researcher protocol.

sources.quote: two technicians with process engineering backgrounds who track sorting-line performance data daily
Will the company provide site access, technician time and permission for data use or publication, and what IP terms would apply?

issues.explanation: The material never states that the company will release its two technicians from sorting-line duties, grant field access, or hand over its records; the task card itself lists these as open questions. Reword as conditional offers to be confirmed (e.g. 'subject to the company confirming technician time, site access and data sharing') rather than assigning them as agreed roles.
